text:
customer-success-jd: Hey team, acme (org: org_85xx) saw 429s last night and then their monthly credits appeared to refill ~4h earlier than their local midnight (PST). Customer expects refill at 00:00 America/Los_Angeles but API started accepting requests again at ~20:00 PST. Can we confirm timing and repro steps?

alice: thanks — can you paste the org id and the plan tier? also any API response snippets (429 body) or client timestamps helps.

customer-success-jd: org_85xx, plan: team-monthly. 429 body was just standard rate_limit: "monthly_quota_exhausted" with x-reset-time header: "2024-11-01T04:00:00Z". Client reported 2024-10-31T20:05:12-08:00 as first success after refill. Quick log snippet:```
[2024-10-31T19:58:50-08:00] POST /v1/generate -> 429 monthly_quota_exhausted
[2024-10-31T20:05:12-08:00] POST /v1/generate -> 200 OK
```

ben: could be edge cache TTL + backend refill in UTC. we've seen the refill job run at 04:00Z (== 20:00 PDT) when something bumped the job schedule or a legacy flag was set.

carla: I can check cronjob logs and the refill job run times. quick check command:```bash
kubectl logs deployment/quota-refill -n infra --since=6h | grep org_85xx
```
I can also run a manual refill dry-run:```bash
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" https://internal.redwood/api/admin/refill?org=org_85xx&dry_run=true
```

support-bot: quota-reset-cron: last_run=2024-11-01T04:00:02Z status=success affected_tenants=123; config=monthly-window-v1 (note: rollout: legacy).

alice: hypothesis: tenant is on legacy monthly-window-v1 which is anchored to UTC midnight, and UI/client expects local-midnight semantics. For PST (UTC-8) that maps to 16:00 local the previous day when daylight/time offsets shift — but here the observed 20:00 matches 04:00Z. Could be DST flag mismatch or tenant timezone metadata missing.

alice: repro steps to validate locally: 1) create a test tenant on team-monthly. 2) exhaust quota via looped requests. 3) check /v1/usage and x-reset-time header. 4) inspect refill cron logs and edge cache TTL. Commands:```bash
# hit until exhausted
while true; do curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"x"}' >/dev/null || break; done
# inspect header after 429
curl -I -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

carla: I'll pull the quota-refill logs and the cron schedule; if it's a rollout flag mismatch we need infra to flip the migration gating. Escalating to infra if logs show monthly-window-v1 for this org.

customer-success-jd: thanks — customer is very sensitive to perceived early refills (they rely on local midnight billing windows). I'll ask for ETA and share we have logs and the x-reset-time header.

ben: one more note — long-lived streaming sessions can mask perceived timing: if a streaming connection opened before reset remains authenticated and the edge permits tokens from cached state, that can look like an early refill. check streaming session timestamps too.

carla: confirmed from logs: quota-refill job ran 2024-11-01T04:00:02Z and org_85xx is on monthly-window-v1. Opening infra ticket INF-4893 to migrate tenant to monthly-window-v2 (local-midnight semantics). Will update here once migration scheduled.

alice: filed a short KB note (internal) about verifying x-reset-time header and tenant window config. linking when available. :sparkles:

customer-success-jd: appreciated. I'll relay to the customer and ask if they want wait for migration or be moved immediately.

carla: will post final migration time here.
